notes: V133: SKAN POCHINEN. Prichina 1: vstavka v snapshots VALUES(17 znakov) bez spiska kolonok - a v boevoy baze 18 kolonok (chuzhaya 'pdata' ot drugogo instrumenta) -> 'table snapshots has 18 columns but 17 values were supplied' -> skan padal KAZHDYY raz. Teper vstavka so SPISKOM kolonok (8 mest: snapshots/derived/links/params/family/history/health) - rabotaet i na baze s chuzhoy kolonkoy, i bez neyo, pdata NE zatirayetsya. Prichina 2: db_dir pust -> publikovali v papku instrumenta, a chitali so sklada. Teper: db_dir pust -> papka ryadom so SKLADOM; poslednyaya kopiya i bekapy - ryadom s boevoy bazoy; otsev pamyatnikov (plm_reader_before_*.db) i chernovikov (.tmp). Provereno na boevoy baze: params 210, family 53, history 496, pdata 12952 sohranena.
